---
title: "Line Loading"
format: html
---

## Overview

Line data stores ordered point traces per frame (for example: whisker contours).

Supported line formats:

| Format | Typical Source | Available In |
|---|---|---|
| `csv` (single-file or multi-file) | Tracker output CSVs | Data Import Widget and JSON |
| `hdf5` | Structured line datasets | Data Import Widget and JSON |
| `binary` / `capnp` | CapnProto serialized line files | Data Import Widget and JSON |

::: {.callout-note}
## JSON Data Type Name
Use `"data_type": "line"` in JSON.
:::

## Data Import Widget

Open **Modules -> Data Import**, choose **Line Data**, then select:

- **CSV**: single-file or one-file-per-frame mode
- **HDF5**: single file or folder pattern mode
- **Binary**: CapnProto binary line file

The widget also supports post-load spatial scaling.

## JSON: CSV Single-File Lines

Single-file CSV expects one row per frame with quoted x-list and y-list values.

```text
Frame,"12.0,13.0,14.0","220.5,221.0,222.1"
```

```json
{
	"filepath": "tracking/lines.csv",
	"data_type": "line",
	"name": "whisker_line",
	"format": "csv",
	"multi_file": false,
	"delimiter": ",",
	"coordinate_delimiter": ",",
	"has_header": true,
	"header_identifier": "Frame",
	"image_width": 640,
	"image_height": 480
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `multi_file` | No | boolean | `false` | `false` selects single-file parsing |
| `delimiter` | No | string | `","` | Delimiter between frame/X/Y columns |
| `coordinate_delimiter` | No | string | `","` | Delimiter inside quoted coordinate lists |
| `has_header` | No | boolean | `true` | Skip first row if it is a header |
| `header_identifier` | No | string | `"Frame"` | Header label used to identify frame column |
| `image_width` | No | integer | none | Optional image width metadata |
| `image_height` | No | integer | none | Optional image height metadata |

## JSON: CSV Multi-File Lines

Multi-file mode expects one CSV per frame, where filename stem is the frame number (for example `000123.csv`).

```json
{
	"filepath": "tracking/line_frames",
	"data_type": "line",
	"name": "whisker_line",
	"format": "csv",
	"multi_file": true,
	"delimiter": ",",
	"x_column": 0,
	"y_column": 1,
	"has_header": true
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filepath` | Yes | string | - | Directory containing per-frame CSV files |
| `x_column` | No | integer | `0` | 0-based x column index |
| `y_column` | No | integer | `1` | 0-based y column index |
| `has_header` | No | boolean | `true` | Skip first row in each file |

## JSON: HDF5 Lines

```json
{
	"filepath": "tracking/lines.h5",
	"data_type": "line",
	"name": "whisker_line",
	"format": "hdf5",
	"frame_key": "frames",
	"x_key": "y",
	"y_key": "x",
	"image_width": 640,
	"image_height": 480
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frame_key` | No | string | `"frames"` | Dataset path for frame indices |
| `x_key` | No | string | `"y"` | Dataset path for x values |
| `y_key` | No | string | `"x"` | Dataset path for y values |
| `image_width` | No | integer | none | Optional image width metadata |
| `image_height` | No | integer | none | Optional image height metadata |

::: {.callout-note}
Some HDF5 line exports store coordinate datasets swapped (`x_key = "y"`, `y_key = "x"`), which is why those are the current defaults.
:::

## JSON: Binary CapnProto Lines

```json
{
	"filepath": "tracking/lines.capnp",
	"data_type": "line",
	"name": "whisker_line",
	"format": "binary",
	"image_width": 640,
	"image_height": 480
}
```

`format` may be either `"binary"` or `"capnp"` for line data.
